responsibility: Implements shared AST-building helpers for Rust comparison-trait derivation in the expansion subsystem. This file constructs paired self/other field or tuple-index expressions and generates MatchCase nodes that destructure the same enum variant from both operands, creating unique binding patterns for tuple and struct variants and passing the resulting bound-expression pairs to a caller-supplied lambda so trait-specific derive code such as Ord or PartialOrd can synthesize the comparison result.
same_name_distinction: Defines the out-of-line behavior for the comparison-derive support declared in rust-derive-cmp-common.h: it materializes SelfOther field/index pairs and builds enum tuple/struct MatchCase nodes with generated self/other bindings and caller-supplied result expressions.
